meta.title: Claimant count by age (monthly)
meta.quality: Official statistics in development (ONS). Administrative count, not a survey: no sampling error. Latest month is provisional and can be revised.
meta.limitations: Since Universal Credit full service the count includes UC claimants required to search for work, including some who are employed on low earnings, so it is NOT a measure of unemployment and is not comparable with pre-2013 JSA-only counts. Counts rounded to nearest 5 (so 16-17 is very noisy). Rates are computed in this pipeline with ONS MYE denominators (Nomis only publishes the all-age rate at LA level) and may differ slightly from ONS-published rates. Not seasonally adjusted.

indicators.label: Claimant rate 16-17
indicators.description: Claimants as % of residents aged 16-17 (ONS mid-year estimate for that year, latest available MYE for months after it). Computed here, not by ONS.

indicators.label: Claimant rate 18-24
indicators.description: Claimants as % of residents aged 18-24 (ONS mid-year estimate for that year, latest available MYE for months after it). Computed here, not by ONS.
